item.title: Ghosh Named to ICR Strategy Post
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260217090347_021325SukantiGhosh.webp" alt="Sukanti Ghosh" />Sukanti Ghosh, who has held senior leadership roles at Albright Stonebridge Group, APCO Worldwide, Barclays and Bank Muscat, is joining ICR as partner, international strategy &amp; markets.</p>

item.title: IGB Group Sails With ZIM
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260217091748_021726Zim.webp" alt="Zim" />New York&rsquo;s IGB Group is providing strategic communications services to Zim Integrated Shipping Services, which has 129 vessels, as the Israeli company is acquired by Germany&rsquo;s Hapag-Lloyd in a deal valued at $4.2B.</p>

item.title: Research Pro Guterl Takes RF Post
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260217110809_021726JeremyGuterl.webp" alt="Jeremy Gutari" />Jeremy Guterl, a veteran of Ketchum Analytics and Edelman Berland, has joined Ruder Finn as senior VP-research and analytics.</p>

item.title: Murphy/DeBlasio Aide Moves to MWW
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260217141039_021726Mahen.webp" alt="Mahen" />Mahen Gunaratna, who was chief strategy advisor and communications director to former New Jersey Governor Phil Murphy&nbsp;and deputy communications director for ex-NYC Mayor Bill&nbsp;de&nbsp;Blasio, is coming on board at&nbsp;MikeWorldWide&nbsp;as EVP of public affairs.</p>

item.title: Communicators Drive Workplace AI Adoption
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20190111125613_022018IPR.jpg" alt="IPR" />Communicators are often catalysts for workplace AI adoption, serving a vital role in translating this adoption between an organization's technical teams and its broader staff, according to IPR research.</p>

item.title: Prosek Targets Japanese Toilet Bowl Maker
item.description: <p><img align=left style="float: left;" src="https://www.odwyerpr.com/site_images/20260217102252_021726Toto.webp" alt="Toto" />Prosek Partners represents UK activist investor Palliser Capital, which claims Japan&rsquo;s Toto Ltd, the country's top toilet bowl maker, ranks as an undervalued AI asset play.</p>
